column1: # Normative dependencies of this implementation on metadatastician/standards,
# at the revision in .ci/pins.sh. Three TAB-separated fields per line:
# scripts/standards/contract.sh asserts that every literal still appears in
# the pinned file. That is how a revision that keeps every filename but moves
# the goalposts is caught: a hash mismatch cannot see it, because the new file
# is a valid new policy. Removing or reflowing a pinned sentence in standards
# therefore stops this repository's update proposal at exit 3, for a human to
# rule on, instead of silently retargeting the tests.

column3: Rule J-1: JSON is I-JSON, serialised by JCS
followed by exactly one line feed
Rule J-2: JSON Lines is one canonical record per line
a gate that cannot look must not report a pass
a .jsonl without a final newline fails --enforce
